description_en: Generates a coordination code for the current account's connected cloud desktop. You can share this code with other accounts to allow them to connect to the same cloud desktop
description_zh: 为当前账号和连接中的云电脑生成一个协同码，通过将协同码分享给其他账号，可以让其他账号连接到当前云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun metaspace generate-coordination-code --login-token v2c4e2ef03d62000000 --session-id 09e2b2e6-3181000000 --resource-id ecd-68a7ddrt0000000 --resource-type CloudDesktop --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-name demo-desktop --login-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateCoordinationCode

parameters.help_en:
Resource ID.

> Resource IDs vary by resource type.
>
> - `CloudDesktop`: The resource ID is the cloud desktop ID, such as `ecd-68a7ddrt0******`.
>
> - `CloudApp`: The resource ID is the application instance ID, such as `ai-0cbg3f097lq******`
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

> 不同的资源类型，对应的资源ID也不相同。
> - `CloudDesktop`  资源ID为云电脑ID，如`ecd-68a7ddrt0******`。
> - `CloudApp` 资源ID为应用实例ID，如`ai-0cbg3f097lq******`
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: Login region ID. This is the region ID of the office network when users log on through an office network
parameters.help_zh: 登录地域ID。用户通过办公网络登录时，办公网络所属的地域ID
parameters.name: login_region_id
